name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Tesla, $44k, and $54k go with Dam, Pipeline, and Rover, in some order.

$44k does not go with Skyscraper if and only if Rover does not go with $49k.
Either Tesla goes with $54k or Dam goes with $54k.
